title: Implement versioned M4 Stage Module and result contracts
goal: Add explicit semantic version 2 contracts while preserving v1 authorities as visible legacy untyped input.
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic Profiles declare version 2 and an exact dependency freshness and local trust policy.
Semantic built-in providers declare V4-AD-041 result kinds and retain read-only no-network no-process constraints.
Semantic Stage results distinguish role result kind outcome execution source timing content identity and producer trust.
Every existing v1 Profile Module result and stable Stage command remains valid and is not silently reinterpreted.
risks: Additive semantic rules could invalidate or reinterpret the stable v1 contract.
decisions: Use an isolated explicit formatVersion 2 authority tree while preserving the frozen formatVersion 1 contracts as legacy untyped.
